angle: Movement translation, DL (top cell of a 40-cell 5-group screen): same-player match between the Combine first-step launch (pass-rush drill and 40) and launch on 20 random NFL rushes; is the carry-over personal or body type, and does the drill-to-game match explain pressure beyond draft pick, weight and role. Revision of round_03/cand_3.
metric_name: Launch gap = shrunk NFL launch minus shrunk Combine pass-rush-drill launch (launch = peak forward acceleration in the first second after first movement, yd/s^2, one function on drill and game tracking), in true-score sd; plus curve-shape match and speed retention by phase
headline_number: First half-second matched (98% of drill speed at 0.5 s, 82% at 1.0 s, 54% at 2.0 s). 40 launch -> NFL launch rho 0.36 [0.14, 0.54] (n=69, best-of-40 p 0.276) but a same-role nearest-weight lookalike's NFL launch is previewed equally (0.35; own closer for 48%). Gap vs pressure partial rho 0.12 [-0.16, 0.39], held-out dR2 -0.006; nested whole-pipeline LOCO dR2 -0.015 [-0.330, 0.002], 0 of 3 folds positive; worth 0.4 pressures/season per sd.
what_changed_from_previous: Revises round_03/cand_3 (7.45) with the round-3 winner's top_changes: (1) writeup.md is rendered from writeup_template.md with every number pulled from numbers.json keys, so text, tables and figures cannot disagree; baseline R2 differences across rows shown with n in the appendix table; (2) new lookalike placebo shows the Combine-to-NFL launch carry-over is body type/role, not personal; (3) symmetric nested leave-one-class-out of the whole pipeline (40-cell screen + choice among 5 measures redone per fold) with a 300-redraw distribution of held-out dR2; DL launch is chosen in only 1 of 3 folds; (4) placebo outcome (run-stop rate) and gap x EDGE-share interaction; (5) GM translation: pressures per season and draft-slot equivalent with intervals, selection into the 100-rush cohort and games-played caveat; (6) new hero figure of speed retention by phase (first half-second matched, split at contact) tying the null to technique after contact; (7) ~60-word football-first opening plus why-DL/why-now, coaching definition first, stats moved to appendix, pre-registered test before Limitations, rule-based 'Read' column for named players; (8) figures re-cut: single-message titles, fonts >= 9.5 pt, n per card, one heatmap screen, forest with nested and placebo rows. 1,966 words, 5 figures + 2 tables.
open_risks: Headline is a null for production: Football judges penalised nulls; the decision rules (zero weight on tracked drill launch, do not flag 'not playing to his Combine', scout post-contact) are the payoff
Lookalike test CIs are wide (own minus lookalike, 40: 0.01 [-0.28, 0.31]); it fails to show a personal component rather than proving none exists, and matches only role and weight
The screen choice is unstable (best-of-40 p 0.276; nested folds pick WR/TE top speed twice), so even the translation lead is fragile
Speed-retention-by-phase is descriptive: no blocker in the drill, no opponents/ball in game tracking, so 'contact at ~0.5-1 s' is inferred, not observed
Placebo outcome leans negative (-0.19), plausibly because lighter rushers launch harder and make fewer run tackles; judges may ask for a weight-adjusted run-defense outcome
Overlaps the Hoop G line of the main writeup only on DL; does not engage the bend lead
